briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Developments from roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026, drawn only from the search results provided. No hiring news was found.

## What changed (last 30 days)

**Deals**
- A wire report says Zepto has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter. The snippet does not explicitly name Zepto, so confirm the target before relying on it. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)
- A social media post dated 7 November claims a "Zepto valuation 7 billion." This is an unverified user post. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)

**Launches and marketing**
- Zepto ran a brand activation tied to Seoul Street and said Anime India is next. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta commented. Zepto did not say which fandom comes next. A Hyderabad fan event was scheduled for 14 November. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago)

**Demand and operations**
- Zepto delivered over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour during Dhanteras 2026, as festive quick-commerce demand surged. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm)
- Zepto recorded 3X growth in festive hamper orders versus last Diwali. (https://www.ndtvprofit.com/business/from-gold-coins-to-diet-coke-what-diwali-shopping-carts-reveal-about-indias-consumption-12309693)

**Regulation**
- Maharashtra's FDA suspended food licences for Blinkit, Zepto and 103 others, with actions taken on 4 and 5 November. The suspensions covered 105 licences in total. (https://www.rediff.com/news/commentary/2026/nov/06/fda-suspends-food-licence-of-blinkit-zepto-103-others/14358878a29915ea01709670aa484bc5)

**Workforce**
- Zepto moved its post-Diwali scheduled holiday from Tuesday to Monday. HR chief Sneha Arora said the aim was a longer weekend for employees. (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms)
- A viral video alleged a delivery partner received "cash-like coupons" instead of a cash Diwali bonus. Commenters criticised gig-worker welfare. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)

**Hires:** No hiring or leadership changes were found in the results.

## Background (undated or older)
- Company profile: Zepto Marketplace Private Limited, founded 2021, headquartered in India, privately held. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)
- Funding entries listed: a $450M Series H dated 2025-11-16 and a $100M venture round dated 2026-07-01. Both fall outside the 30-day window. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)

## Open questions
1. Is Zepto the company in the Globex acquisition report, and what is the status of the deal and its expected close?
2. What steps are being taken on the Maharashtra licence suspensions, and how is compliance being handled across food operations?
3. How is Zepto responding to the Diwali bonus complaints, and what is its policy on delivery-partner pay and benefits?
